scene:
Three zones read left to right, separated by generous space.

LEFT ZONE (narrow), the company's needs, three small icons stacked vertically, each with its label beneath: a gear with a small checklist, labelled AUTOMATE ONBOARDING; a globe with a flag pin, labelled SECOND COUNTRY; an older person holding a handover folder towards a younger person, labelled FOUNDER RETIRES. A thin navy bracket on their right side leads with one arrow into the middle zone.

MIDDLE ZONE (widest), two tall investor cards side by side, each examined by a large magnifying glass hovering at its top edge. The left card has a building icon at the top and is labelled INVESTOR A €5M; below, two rows each with one icon: an hourglass labelled MORE MONEY TOOK 4 MONTHS, and a blank sheet of paper with a crossed-out pen labelled NO WRITTEN CRITERIA. The right card has a smaller building icon and is labelled INVESTOR B €4.5M; below, two rows each with one icon: a fast arrow hitting a target, labelled FUNDING IN 6 WEEKS, and a swapped office chair with a small ochre warning triangle, labelled REPLACED FINANCE CHIEF. A large ochre check mark and a stamp labelled CHOSEN sit on the right card only.

RIGHT ZONE, a vertical path of four steps connected by downward navy arrows, starting from the chosen card: (1) a stopwatch beside a small bar chart, labelled PILOT ≤ 65 HOURS; (2) a signed request letter, labelled VALID REQUEST; (3) a blank calendar page with an empty grid (no digits on it) beside a coin stack, labelled €1.5M PAID WITHIN 30 DAYS; (4) a wallet with coins going in, labelled SPEND ONLY CASH RECEIVED.

All documents, letters and papers are blank or show only wavy lines, with no letters on them; coins and calendars carry no symbols or numbers.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: AUTOMATE ONBOARDING, SECOND COUNTRY, FOUNDER RETIRES, INVESTOR A €5M, MORE MONEY TOOK 4 MONTHS, NO WRITTEN CRITERIA, INVESTOR B €4.5M, FUNDING IN 6 WEEKS, REPLACED FINANCE CHIEF, CHOSEN, PILOT ≤ 65 HOURS, VALID REQUEST, €1.5M PAID WITHIN 30 DAYS, SPEND ONLY CASH RECEIVED. Any other text is a defect.
alt: Rotaline’s three next decisions, automating onboarding, a second country and a retiring founder, set the needs; two investor cards are compared on evidence: Investor A offers €5 million but more money took four months and it gives no written criteria, while Investor B offers €4.5 million, provided funding in six weeks and once replaced a finance chief, and is chosen; a path shows a pilot at 65 hours or less leading to a valid request and a €1.5 million follow-on paid within thirty days, with only cash received spent.
caption: Start from the company’s next decisions, compare investors on how they behaved under pressure, and spend only the money that has arrived.
